text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black continues to hone her 
running. If she keeps growing at this 
rate, she will surely become the strongest 
front runner. And so—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown went to Hong Kong to devise 
her strategy. There, she took part in a 
mock race. Her opponent was an Umamusume 
who conquered the world through 
'front-running.'

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through repeated mock races, she grasped 
her path to victory. That was... honing 
Satono Crown's unique traits to acquire 
the "ultimate finishing kick."
